findings.text: §36's second case says the test "drives `_fold_findings_into_round` twice for one round and asserts one commit in total", but the fold makes two commits on its first sweep whenever the round carries one open finding and one open dimension (the finding record write and the dimension write each go through `commit_record_write` as separate commits to the same file); "one commit in total" holds only for a round whose finding is already folded, and the section does not say the fixture is built that way
